## Verdict

## Concerns
- Claim-3 misnumbers the equations. Counting native TeX numbered environments, equation (8) is the decomposable system [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 332-340], equation (9) defines \(\mathrm{CP}\) [lines 387-397], and equation (10) is the algorithm update [lines 625-632]. The system at lines 793-796 is equation (11).
- Claim-5 is false and contradicts the Strategy. Lines 667-705 contain Proposition 3.12 and Lemma 3.13, not items 4.4–4.5. The actual Theorems 4.4 and 4.5 occur at lines 790-818 and 819-826, respectively.
- Consequently, although the native archive, retrieval URL, and hash were supplied, the requested excerpt is not reported consistently and cannot yet be considered established.

## Unresolved certificates
- [source-refresh] Replace claims 3 and 5 with a self-consistent, line-located transcription of equations (8)–(10) at lines 332-340, 387-397, and 625-632, and Theorems 4.4–4.5 at lines 790-826, preserving the stated arXiv identity, retrieval URL, and SHA-256.
